subject: Embed units, dimensions eligibility & commercial packaging question
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir@smartsearch.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-18 15:02 PDT
Subject: Quick Q on embeddings pricing and model support

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo earlier. We have a milestone to decide on a vendor for our semantic search back end by end of quarter. I had a few quick, specific questions so I can pull together a recommendation for procurement: 

- How do you bill embeddings today — per-vector or per-token (or both)? Is there a standard minimum unit?
- Are dimensions (e.g., 512 vs 1536) charged differently? If so, what are the breakpoints?
- Which embedding families/models are covered under the hosted rate card (open models vs Redwood-verified models)? Any restrictions on using quantized variants for inference?
- Do you offer short-term evaluation bundles (e.g., 1M vectors at a discounted rate) or entry-level committed packs?

If you can send the current rate card and any short example calculations that show typical monthly cost for 10M vectors at 1536 dims, that'd be great. Also, is there any packaging or discounting for startups?

Best,
Samir
Director of Search
SmartSearch.ai
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <samir@smartsearch.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-18 15:36 PDT
Subject: Re: Quick Q on embeddings pricing and model support

Hi Samir — thanks for the thoughtful list. I can get you the rate card and an example calc. Quick answers inline then I'll attach the formal PDF: 

- Billing: hosted embeddings are metered by "vector units". Each vector is counted as 1 unit; we also publish token-equivalent estimates for model compatibility.
- Dimensions: pricing tiers are dimension-aware. Typically we have baseline tiers (<=512, 513-1024, 1025-2048, >2048) with per-unit multipliers.
- Models: the hosted rate card covers our curated set (Redwood-verified) and a set of partner open models. We allow quantized inference on supported families but price parity depends on performance profile — some quantized variants are eligible for a lower multiplier.
- Packs: yes — we offer evaluation packs and month-to-month committed bundles. I will include an example calc for 10M vectors at 1536 dims in the attachment.

I'll loop Marissa (pricing lead) for the detailed packaging and Ben for any startup program details. Expect the rate card PDF in a follow-up within the hour.

— Vivek
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-18 16:05 PDT
Subject: Re: Quick Q on embeddings pricing and model support

Vivek / Ben — drafting the rate card excerpt now. A couple of product clarifications I want to confirm before we send: 

1) For hosted embeddings we bill by vector unit; dimensions map to multipliers. Current multipliers: <=512 = 1.0x, 513-1024 = 1.4x, 1025-2048 = 1.9x. These are baseline and vary by model family.

2) Model support: list to include: Redwood-Base-embed-v1 (default), Redwood-Text-embed-compact, OpenSearch-embed-1.1 (partner). Note: we will not permit modified private forks on hosted plan. Quantized variants are supported on dedicated/private and selectively on hosted depending on perf tests.

3) Packs: Draft an "Evaluation Pack" (1M vectors @ 25% off), "Starter" (10M vectors prepaid, 12-month term, 10% off), and "Scale" (100M vectors, custom pricing). We should include an explicit example calc for 10M @ 1536 dims (1536 falls into 1025-2048 multiplier).

Ben — please confirm whether startup credits are still being offered under the standard startup program or needs AE approval.

Marissa
Director, Pricing and Packaging
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-18 17:10 PDT
Subject: Re: Quick Q on embeddings pricing and model support

Quick note — startup credits: we have a rolling program but for ARR-impacting accounts we surface an "early commercial credit" that requires approval from Sales Ops. For SmartSearch.ai (revenue profile looks healthy), propose offering: 

- Evaluation Pack: 1M vectors at 25% off (no contract)
- Starter Commit: 10M vectors, 12-month prepay, 12% off + one month free onboarding credits

If they ask for deeper discounting on Starter, we can offer an additional 3% in exchange for a logo/reference commitment and a 6-month case study window.

Ben
Account Executive
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <samir@smartsearch.ai>, Natalie Park <natalie.legal@dataworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-19 10:30 PDT
Subject: Re: Embed units, dimensions eligibility & commercial packaging question

Hi Samir / Natalie — attaching our current excerpted rate card and a short worked example for 10M vectors at 1536 dims. Highlights below: 

- Metering: 1 vector = 1 vector unit. Token-equivalent guidance included for adapter flows.
- Dimension tiers & baseline multipliers: <=512 (1.0x); 513–1024 (1.4x); 1025–2048 (1.9x). 1536 dims uses the 1.9x multiplier.
- Models included on hosted rate card: Redwood-Base-embed-v1, Redwood-Text-embed-compact, OpenSearch-embed-1.1. Quantized hosted variants are approved per model after perf verification.
- Starter commercial offer (recommended): 10M vector prepay, 12-month term, 12% off list, includes 40k tokens of generation credits for evaluation. If you need month-to-month, we have a 1M evaluation pack at 25% off.

Attachments: Redwood_Embed_Ratecard_2028_v1.pdf (ratecard excerpt + example calc), Example_Cost_Calc_10M_1536.csv (worked numbers).

Next steps: let me know which pack you'd like to trial; Ben will follow up to set up procurement and any commercial paperwork. If legal wants standard SOW/redlines, Natalie, loop me in and we can accelerate with our contracts team.

Best,
Vivek
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
